thread:
James (Customer Sec): Hey team — bank asked for an evidence bundle for KMS/HSM usage, RBAC mappings, and sample audit logs for SIEM ingestion. They want answers before Tuesday's review call. Can we pull what they need?
Leah M (SecEng): We can provide a redacted audit bundle + role mappings. need to confirm exact fields they want in logs (actor, action, resource, key_id, request_id, result).
Mike R (Infra): For HSM: we have customer-key envelope flow documented. We can produce: key provenance (creation_time, origin=hsm, key_uuid), rotation events, and KMS access logs with caller identity.
Sara (Solutions): Also confirm whether they need full request bodies or just headers/metadata — they usually ask for redacted payloads. Gabe from legal prefers minimal PII.
James (Customer Sec): They requested: - proof of HSM-backed KEKs - role matrix mapping to SCIM groups - sample audit logs for a deny and allow path - retention policy and export for SIEM (Splunk/QRadar) - explanation of emergency key rotation process
Leah M (SecEng): OK. Plan: 1) export RBAC CSV mapping service accounts -> RBAC roles -> SCIM group name 2) produce a 24-hour sample of audit logs (redacted) in JSONL with schema we send 3) short write-up: HSM proof, key lifecycle, rotation, split keys if applicable 4) SIEM ingest sample with mapping guide.
Mike R (Infra): For the SIEM sample, I'll generate a small script that converts our audit lines to Splunk HEC JSON; make sure to include kafka offset + log_sha so customer can correlate. Example snippet: ```
{
  "time": 1678890000,
  "host": "redwood-kms-01",
  "event": {"actor":"service-account:ingest-batcher","action":"Decrypt","resource":"/v1/keys/ke-123","key_id":"ke-123","result":"ALLOW","request_id":"req-9a8b"}
}
```
Sara (Solutions): I'll draft the RBAC CSV. We should mark rows that contain built-in platform roles vs. customer-scoped roles. Also include a note about canaries/cross-tenant protections.
James (Customer Sec): For HSM proof they also want attestation chain or vendor cert. Do we have vendor-signed attestation docs?
Leah M (SecEng): We can provide HSM vendor cert + evidence that keys were generated with origin=HSM in metadata. We do not ship raw HSM attestations by default; ops needs to pull the attestation statement from the HSM provider portal (I can request it).
Mike R (Infra): Note: for Private deployments we can include customer-managed HSM logs; for hosted, we provide vendor cert + KMS audit that shows origin. Clarify which deployment the customer runs.
James (Customer Sec): They're on Hosted API. Good to know.
Sara (Solutions): On retention: our default audit retention is 90 days in hot store, 1 year in cold bucket. We can produce exports beyond that on request (SLA/fee). I'll include the retention policy text.
Leah M (SecEng): Vulnerability triage note: if they ask about CVE mapping or recent patches, reference our vuln tracker link and the last maint window (2026-01-14). Provide a summary table of outstanding CVEs and mitigation status. Keep it high level.
Mike R (Infra): Also highlight RBAC emergency workflows: emergency access tickets require two approvers and leave an immutable audit trail with keystamp. We can show a sanitized example ticket ID and its logs.
James (Customer Sec): Great. For the sample logs, can you also include a denied access example where a service token tried to access a key outside its tenant? That shows multi-tenant enforcement.
Leah M (SecEng): Yep. I'll craft a deny/allow pair and include explanation lines.
Sara (Solutions): Who will assemble the bundle and own the delivery? I'll volunteer to coordinate and produce the cover letter for the customer's SQ.
Leah M (SecEng): I can prepare the HSM/key lifecycle write-up + redaction of logs. Mike — can you produce the SIEM sample + conversion script by EOD tomorrow?
Mike R (Infra): On it. Will drop artifacts to gs://redwood-sec-evidence/1776549999/ and ping when ready.
security-bot: Reminder: please run `sq-evidence-sanitize --redact-email --redact-ids` before uploading.
James (Customer Sec): Thanks everyone. Can we aim to send the bundle Monday morning? Customer needs time to review before Tuesday call.
Sara (Solutions): Monday AM works. I'll assemble and send with a small README explaining redactions and contact for follow-ups.
Leah M (SecEng): Optional: we should offer to do a 20-min pre-call to walk them through the artifacts. saves time on the Tuesday review.
James (Customer Sec): Yes please. Add a calendar invite after bundle goes out.
Mike R (Infra): Quick Q: do we need a formal signed statement for key provenance? If yes, will legal need to sign off.
Leah M (SecEng): If they demand a formal attestation, loop Legal. Otherwise vendor cert + log evidence is usually sufficient.
Sara (Solutions): I'll draft the README + checklist and post here when done.
James (Customer Sec): Awesome — appreciate the quick turn.
Leah M (SecEng): uploading RBAC CSV and sample logs draft in thread when ready.
